decisions.statement: A venue is closed only where the run is at the step that venue belongs to.
Each job that can outlast the opening is asked whether it is still working.
A question still on the screen counts as work still going.
A venue the player closed first is left alone.
Nothing here decides how long a venue is held.
Which interaction each venue is is written here rather than read from the game.

definition: the venue window closed once nothing the addon started there is still working
